export function findEquation(reactantIds) {
  return equations.find(
    (eq) => eq.reactants.every((r) => reactantIds.includes(r))
  ) || null;
}
export function canReact(c1, c2) {
  return equations.some(
    (eq) => eq.reactants.includes(c1) && eq.reactants.includes(c2)
  );
}
